title: Security Measures at Preschools to Prevent Intrusions by Unauthorised Persons
what_it_is: Security Measures at Preschools to Prevent Intrusions by Unauthorised Persons

sections.label: Preschool security and emergency rules
sections.summary: ECDA requires preschools to secure premises, record entry and exit, have safety SOPs, and conduct evacuation exercises every six months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) has regulations that require preschools to put in place measures to protect children and staff from security threats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: All preschools are required to keep their premises secured to prevent any unauthorised personnel from entering the centre.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Most preschools use electronic locks at the entrance and visitors are only allowed entry after checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Every preschool must have procedures in place to check and record the entry and exit of all persons.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: All preschools are also required to establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) to handle safety-related incidents, injuries and emergency evacuation during a crisis.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Emergency evacuation exercises for all children and staff in preschools must be conducted every six months.

sections.label: ECDA licensing visits and seminars
sections.summary: ECDA licensing officers conduct regular visits to check preschool compliance, and ECDA works with SPF on Counter Terrorism seminars.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: ECDA’s licensing officers conduct regular licensing and supervisory visits to ensure preschools comply with our regulatory measures to keep their children safe and secure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: ECDA collaborates with the Singapore Police Force (SPF) to organise Counter Terrorism seminars for preschools under SGSecure.
